text: this model isnt the model? or what am i misunderstanding [Image #5]
resolution: Answered + fixed the silence that caused the question. The blocky figure is the loader's built-in STAND-IN (navy legs, green torso, skin head, dark visor — world_loader.zig fallbackPlayerModel), not any export. It mounts because no package on disk currently declares role:'player': Player_Model_2's manifest says role:'npc' (its latest character export picked the NPC card; player role is exclusive and lives in the manifest) and Player_Model_1 was only ever saved, never exported, so it has no placeable at all. The playtest chip only spoke when a model WAS worn — the empty case was silent, which is the real defect. The chip now always shows and names the cause: no-player-declared vs meshdoc-unreadable, each with the fix path (File → Export → Player Model); AnimationCaptureSurface wording aligned. Re-exporting the mannequin as Player makes the playtest wear it again (with bb1a43663's geom-key fix, without the stale-cube boxes).
